items.headline: GDEV Q2 EPS $1.08 Misses $1.33 Estimate, Sales $93.573M Miss $109.000M Estimate
items.summary: GDEV (NASDAQ:GDEV) reported quarterly earnings of $1.08 per share which missed the analyst consensus estimate of $1.33 by 18.8 percent. This is a 20 percent increase over earnings of $0.90 per share from the same period
